# Attribution

This work includes material from the System Reference Document 5.2.1 (SRD 5.2.1) by Wizards of the Coast LLC, available from D&D Beyond and licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International.

Dungeons & Dolphins provides compact tracking, calculations and reference metadata rather than reproducing the full rulebooks. Contributors should add only material they have the right to redistribute.

The implementation is original. Common Flipper Zero persistence/application patterns and public Flipper projects were reviewed as behavioral references; project code/assets were not copied unless separately identified by their licenses.

Ghost Protocol is original fictional campaign content. References to a Flipper Zero are narrative/game context and do not reproduce device firmware or third-party exploit material.

Language, weapon, armor and tool catalog entries are compact names with original selection metadata. The optional 420 bundle/catalog is original homebrew inventory content and is not attributed to the SRD. Rule verification references the [SRD 5.2.1](https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/srd/5.2/SRD_CC_v5.2.1.pdf); host API signatures were checked against the [Flipper storage API](https://developer.flipper.net/flipperzero/doxygen/storage_8h.html).
